items.prompt: An ancient book lies open on a wooden lectern in a dark stone room, lit by one candle; its pages are covered in faded marks too worn to read, and dust hangs in the candlelight.

alt.ru: Древняя книга раскрыта на деревянном аналое в тёмной каменной комнате при одной свече; знаки на страницах стёрлись, в свете висит пыль.
alt.en: An ancient book open on a wooden lectern in a dark stone room by one candle, its marks worn unreadable, dust in the light.
alt.pt: Um livro antigo aberto numa estante de madeira numa sala de pedra escura, à luz de uma vela, os sinais gastos e ilegíveis, pó no ar.
alt.es: Un libro antiguo abierto en un atril de madera en una sala de piedra oscura, a la luz de una vela, los signos gastados e ilegibles, polvo en el aire.
